g.text: Per recording: average excess mean ΔV for each taxel, then normalize the nine values to 100%.

g.text: Each row averages six recording profiles. Values describe response spread, not prediction accuracy.

g.text: All 7,154 frames retained, including 1,153 zero-total frames. Camera units, not optical power.
